QUOTE: Whether an unlisted call runs depends on whether an `on_tool_call` callback is registered. ... "Default-deny holds only when no callback is registered."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the unlisted call's outcome depends on a callback being registered, and that the deny list is the only blocker once dispatch is reached. It never concludes that the effective posture is default-allow, so the item is not stated.
